captures.label: MALICIOUS
captures.label_derivation: Capture-level label MALICIOUS: Stratosphere Malware Capture Facility Project recording of a Windows VM executing the sample named in the README ('Probable Name'). Every flow of the VM is labelled MALICIOUS, including the minutes before infection and benign background Windows traffic, so flow-level label noise is expected and unquantified.
captures.environment: STRATOSPHERE_LAB_CAPTURE; infected host 192.168.1.116; README lists a MITM proxy interception log; interception point not stated (JA3S may reflect a proxy)
captures.expected_sha256_source: No PCAP checksum is published by the source (README lists only the malware sample hash); SHA-256 observed at acquisition is recorded.
